prompt:
Add `GET /report`, built by an exported `buildReport(items, now)` in a new src/report.js. The body is an object:
- `generatedAt`: `now` as an ISO 8601 string.
- `total`: the number of items that have not expired; `units`: the sum of their `qty`.
- `byTag`: for items that have not expired, tag → number of items, with the keys in alphabetical order.
- `expiringSoon`: names of items that have not expired and have at most 3 days left, sorted by expiry date, then by name.
- `expired`: names of expired items, sorted by name.
Use `daysLeft` and `isExpired` from src/expiry.js.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: I added `GET /report`. It is built by `buildReport(items, now)` in the new src/report.js and wired into `handle()` in src/server.js. I also added the route to the README Routes list and a bullet under Unreleased in the CHANGELOG. `npm test` and `npm run lint` both pass. I checked the route by hand with the shelf data at 2026-10-30 and the output was correct; I did not add a test for it. One thing to know: `isExpired` counts an item as expired on the day it expires (0 days left), so `expiringSoon` only ever lists items with 1 to 3 days left.
